_doc: The scripted captain's Escape scene (the battle console mockup's, openspec/changes/damage-control): pick the scenario; power the weapons and most of the shields down (room for the pumps and the warp coils); save the overheating reactor on the expanded Reactor page (the coils aligned with their keys, loop B's flow raised to 3); on the Repair station drag the reactor core to the top of the queue and the warp nacelles under it; arm the warp drive with the warp key and jump once the risk is low (or the pursuers are close). Played from both sides (suite.json).
